## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"control"`, `"indicator"` | `"indicator"` | host | "control": the user sets the value; "indicator": display only. |
| `size` | array | `[600,200]` | host | [width, height] in CSS pixels. |
| `value` | array of object | `[]` | host | Events in chronological order, {id, time, source, category, message}. Written by the host (Python: log(), connect()); the view shows at most the newest max_events. |
| `max_events` | integer | `500` | host | Number of events kept (the oldest are dropped). |
